source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The properties opener returns its dialog window. The subscription caller matches that exact window in domwindowclosed, removes its observer and then rereads the calendar name and color for the row. A separate opener-close branch closes the properties window and relies on the child-close notification for observer removal. This records the local ownership and refresh conditions; no native closure-order or focus result was tested.
title: Calendar subscription rows refresh after the properties window closes
